visual_identity.core_identity: An oversized predatory centipede defined by its long segmented body, one pair of legs per visible segment, and large front poison claws.
visual_identity.silhouette: Long flexible segmented body forming an S-curve or coil, with many evenly spaced legs creating a saw-tooth edge.
visual_identity.head_features: Small armored head with simple antennae and strong curved forcipule-like poison claws near the mouth.
visual_identity.body_shape: Many repeated trunk segments, each bearing one visible pair of legs, tapering toward the rear.
visual_identity.surface: Simple armored segment plates with minimal texture.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Many body segments each carry one pair of legs, with antennae and front poison claws distinct from walking legs.

accuracy_checks: body is not mistaken for snake

known_failure_modes.symptom: creature drifts toward millipede round body
known_failure_modes.correction: remove millipede round body; restore long segmented body, many paired legs, front poison claws
remove scorpion tail; restore long segmented body, many paired legs, front poison claws
remove spider abdomen; restore long segmented body, many paired legs, front poison claws
